body:
## Pull request overview

Adds an opt-in, backwards-compatible “batch schema sync” capability to reduce kernel bootstrap latency on remote SQL drivers by batching schema introspection + DDL, with safe identifier validation for remote DDL.

**Changes:**
- Introduces `supports.batchSchemaSync` + optional `syncSchemasBatch()` across the spec + driver contracts.
- Implements batched remote DDL in Turso RemoteTransport and exposes it via `TursoDriver.syncSchemasBatch()` (with local/replica sequential fallback).
- Updates `ObjectQLPlugin.syncRegisteredSchemas()` to group objects by driver and use the batch API when available, with runtime fallback to sequential sync.

### Reviewed changes

Copilot reviewed 13 out of 13 changed files in this pull request and generated 4 comments.

<details>
<summary>Show a summary per file</summary>

| File | Description |
| ---- | ----------- |
| packages/spec/src/data/driver.zod.ts | Adds `batchSchemaSync` capability and optional `syncSchemasBatch()` to the driver Zod interface schema. |
| packages/spec/src/data/driver-sql.test.ts | Updates SQL driver capability fixtures to include `batchSchemaSync: false`. |
| packages/spec/src/contracts/data-engine.test.ts | Updates minimal capabilities fixture with `batchSchemaSync: false`. |
| packages/spec/src/contracts/data-driver.ts | Extends `IDataDriver` with optional `syncSchemasBatch()` contract method. |
| packages/spec/src/contracts/data-driver.test.ts | Updates `IDataDriver` capability fixtures to include `batchSchemaSync: false`. |
| packages/plugins/driver-turso/src/turso-driver.ts | Advertises batch support and adds `syncSchemasBatch()` delegating to RemoteTransport in remote mode. |
| packages/plugins/driver-turso/src/turso-driver.test.ts | Adds tests for local fallback batch-sync and remote batch-sync behavior + capability advertisement. |
| packages/plugins/driver-turso/src/remote-transport.ts | Adds `syncSchemasBatch()`, extracts `buildCreateTableSQL()`, and adds `assertSafeIdentifier()` to harden DDL. |
| packages/plugins/driver-sql/src/sql-driver.ts | Explicitly sets `supports.batchSchemaSync: false`. |
| packages/plugins/driver-memory/src/memory-driver.ts | Explicitly sets `supports.batchSchemaSync: false`. |
| packages/objectql/src/plugin.ts | Updates bootstrap schema sync to group by driver and call `syncSchemasBatch()` when supported, with fallback. |
| packages/objectql/src/plugin.integration.test.ts | Adds integration tests ensuring batch path is used when supported and fallback works on failure. |
| CHANGELOG.md | Documents the new batch schema sync feature. |
</details>

The `syncSchemasBatch` docstring says “in a single round-trip”, but batch schema sync typically still performs at least one read batch (introspection) and one write batch (DDL). Please adjust the wording to reflect that this is a batched API that reduces total round-trips, not necessarily a single call.

The `syncSchemasBatch()` comment claims the process reduces to “exactly 2” HTTP round-trips and that it “falls back to sequential syncSchema() if the batch call fails”, but the current implementation may perform 3 batch calls (tables introspection + columns introspection + DDL) and does not catch errors to perform an internal fallback. Please update the comment to match the actual behavior (fallback is handled by the caller) or add the described fallback handling here.
```suggestion
   * Batch-synchronize multiple object schemas using batched libsql calls.
   *
   * Collects all DDL statements (CREATE TABLE / ALTER TABLE ADD COLUMN)
   * for every schema and uses `client.batch()` to minimize network
   * round-trips. The process may perform up to three batch calls:
   * one to introspect existing tables, one to introspect columns for
   * existing tables, and one to apply DDL statements.
   *
   * This method does not implement an internal fallback to sequential
   * `syncSchema()`. Any fallback behavior is expected to be handled
   * by the caller if a batch operation is not supported or fails.
```

This changelog entry says the DDL is sent “in a single client.batch() call” / “single round-trip”, but the implementation uses multiple batch calls (introspection + optional PRAGMA + DDL write). Please reword to avoid overstating the reduction (e.g., “reduces N×(2–3) calls to a small constant number of batch calls”).
```suggestion
  `supports.batchSchemaSync = true`. This reduces the number of remote DDL round-trips from
  roughly N×(2–3) individual calls (introspection + optional PRAGMA + DDL write per object)
  to a small constant number of batched `client.batch()` calls, cutting cold-start times from
  58+ seconds to under 10 seconds for 100+ objects on remote drivers (e.g. Turso cloud).
  Falls back to sequential `syncSchema()` per object for drivers without batch support or if the
  batched calls fail at runtime. Added `batchSchemaSync` capability flag to `DriverCapabilitiesSchema`,
```

The new `batchSchemaSync` capability is described as a “single round-trip DDL”, but the implementation (e.g., Turso RemoteTransport) still requires multiple round-trips for table/column introspection plus DDL application. Consider rewording this capability description to avoid implying a single network call overall (e.g., “supports batched schema sync to reduce round-trips”).
```suggestion
   * into a single (or fewer) round-trips for the DDL phase. When true,
   * the engine may call `syncSchemasBatch()` instead of calling
   * `syncSchema()` per object, reducing network round-trips for remote drivers.
   */
  batchSchemaSync: z.boolean().default(false).describe('Supports batched schema sync to reduce schema DDL round-trips'),
```
